items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I made one with old Floyd Dixon... Floyd and I had a ...(?).... sitting up there. For nine days we sits here and made that program up.

ctx.x: That's really interesting. So there are records of you around if only they could be found.
